# Email to LinkedIn Finder

> Find a LinkedIn profile from a work or personal email by running the Mawsool Email to LinkedIn Finder Actor on Apify.

This repository is an example client. Run the published Mawsool Actor on Apify with your own Apify token. Contact info@mawsool.tech · osama@mawsool.tech. Product site: https://mawsool.tech.

## Actors

- [Email to LinkedIn Finder](https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-email-linkedin-lookup): the Actor this code runs
- [All Mawsool Actors](https://apify.com/oday): the full LinkedIn data suite

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/odayali1/linkedin-email-to-profile/blob/main/README.md): how to run the example and what it returns
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/odayali1/linkedin-email-to-profile/blob/main/AGENTS.md): instructions for coding agents
- [Example CSV](https://github.com/odayali1/linkedin-email-to-profile/blob/main/examples/input.csv): input shape
